description: Prometheus metrics fleetd and experimentd expose on /metrics for the platform health dashboards (DESIGN.md 6.15). Each service's tests hold its registry to this list and the dashboard tests hold every panel to it.

metrics.name: rlworld_fleet_lease_seconds
metrics.help: Time to place, admit and start a lease group, by pool

metrics.name: rlworld_fleet_restore_failures_total
metrics.help: Envs whose snapshot restore or start failed, by pool

metrics.name: rlworld_fleet_step_seconds
metrics.help: Env side step latency split into the env's act and observe time and its settle wait, by pool

metrics.name: rlworld_fleet_step_failures_total
metrics.help: Steps that failed in the env, by pool

metrics.name: rlworld_fleet_leases
metrics.help: Leases held right now, by pool

metrics.name: rlworld_episodes_total
metrics.help: Scored episodes by image and termination

metrics.name: rlworld_app_episodes_total
metrics.help: Scored episodes by app of their world and termination

metrics.name: rlworld_gateway_calls_total
metrics.help: Model gateway calls by endpoint, purpose and outcome

metrics.name: rlworld_gateway_call_seconds
metrics.help: Latency of answered gateway calls that missed the cache; purpose policy is the model part of a step

metrics.name: rlworld_gateway_rate_limit_hits_total
metrics.help: Gateway calls that waited on or were refused by an endpoint rate limit

metrics.name: rlworld_gateway_spend_usd_total
metrics.help: Model spend in USD by purpose; purpose judge is judge spend

metrics.name: rlworld_seats_in_use
metrics.help: License seats leased right now, by product

metrics.name: rlworld_seats_total
metrics.help: License seats in each pool

metrics.name: rlworld_identities_in_use
metrics.help: Identities leased right now, by identity pool

metrics.name: rlworld_identities_total
metrics.help: Identities in each identity pool

metrics.name: rlworld_verifier_precision
metrics.help: Verifier precision against human labels at the last calibration

metrics.name: rlworld_verifier_recall
metrics.help: Verifier recall against human labels at the last calibration

metrics.name: rlworld_replay_divergence_rate
metrics.help: Share of steps whose observation diverged when actions were rerun from the start snapshot

metrics.name: rlworld_clone_fidelity
metrics.help: One minus the success gap between an app clone and the real app at the last measurement

metrics.name: rlworld_run_cost_per_1000_episodes_usd
metrics.help: A run's spend per 1,000 scored episodes
